title: Find Permutation
description:
A permutation `perm` of `n` integers of all the integers in the range `[1, n]` can be represented as a string `s` of length `n - 1` where:

	`s[i] == 'I'` if `perm[i] 
	`s[i] == 'D'` if `perm[i] > perm[i + 1]`.

Given a string `s`, reconstruct the lexicographically smallest permutation `perm` and return it.

examples.explanation: [1,2] is the only legal permutation that can represented by s, where the number 1 and 2 construct an increasing relationship.
Both [2,1,3] and [3,1,2] can be represented as "DI", but since we want to find the smallest lexicographical permutation, you should return [2,1,3]
